about: The one copy of the expected prayer times. The iPhone, Android and web tests and tools/reference_engine.py all read this file, so a wrong time in any app fails its build. Times are local 24h, in the order of 'prayers'. See testdata/README.md.

official.rule: Copied from official timetables. The calculation must never be earlier than these: prayers 0-2 minutes later, sunrise 0-1 minute earlier.

days.source: MUIS 2026 timetable and the prayertime.sg app

exact.rule: What the apps show, to the minute (standard Asr). Pinned so any drift between the three engines shows up at once. A shorter list checks only the first prayers.

wholeYear.rule: testdata/reference-2026.json: every day of 2026 for Singapore, Kuala Lumpur and Jakarta from tools/reference_engine.py final_minutes (minutes after local midnight). Each app must be within 1 minute on every prayer and exact on more than 99.5% of them (only float noise at a minute boundary may differ).
